question: Who are the key partners and advisors at Firgun Ventures? Describe their backgrounds, technical expertise, and relevant deep-tech or quantum experience in 200 words.
answer:
Firgun Ventures is led by a team of academics, entrepreneurs, and finance veterans focused on bridging the "Series A/B gap" in the quantum sector.

Founding Partners

Dr. Kris Naudts (MD, PhD): An academic psychiatrist and neuroscientist (King’s College London) and founder of the travel platform Culture Trip. His interest in quantum is partly driven by its potential to revolutionize medical diagnostics.

Zeynep Korutürk: A former Executive Director at Goldman Sachs who co-founded the firm’s Tech Initiative. She was an early angel investor in Cambridge Quantum Computing (now Quantinuum) in 2016.

Investment Team & Technical Experts

Prof. Mete Atatüre (PhD): An Academic Advisor and world-renowned physicist. He is the Head of the Cavendish Laboratory at the University of Cambridge, providing deep-tech due diligence.

Alexandre Perrin: Principal and former Head of Ventures at XTX Markets, with a background in financial mathematics from Imperial College.

Cedric De Schaut: Head of Gen AI & Data, formerly of Deloitte, specializing in data science and engineering.

Advisory Council

The firm leverages high-level expertise from:

Ilyas Khan (KSG): Founder of Quantinuum and a pioneer in the quantum industry.

Kris Peeters: Former VP of the European Investment Bank and Deputy PM of Belgium.

Yariv Adan: Former Senior Director at Google with 20+ years of experience in AI and infrastructure.

Dr. Martin Murphy: Co-founder of Syncona, bringing extensive life sciences and scale-up experience.
